title: Length Contraction
meaning: A moving object's length measured parallel to its motion is shorter than its rest length.
variables: L₀: proper length in the object's rest frame; L: length in the observer frame; v: relative speed.
conditions: Length endpoints must be measured simultaneously in the measuring observer's frame; contraction occurs along the direction of motion.
commonMistake: Do not mix the two observers' definitions of simultaneous events.
